name: P-008 native protected public HTTPS and visible pairing
summary: One maintained XCUITest passed with zero failures or skips. Actual iOS URLSession requests over public HTTPS verified protected health/workspaces/desktop mint routes return 404 and unauthenticated device heartbeat returns 401. The real app visibly pasted a fresh one-shot pairing payload and loaded authorized Inbox data from an isolated current-source operator through its temporary protected Cloudflare tunnel. No local forwarding route or controlled HTTP responder was used. Screenshot reviewed; 43 native artifact hashes and sizes verified locally. The temporary owned tunnel/DNS, processes, pairing input, private HOME and PostgreSQL data were removed, and the Mac VM lease was released. No prior passed native tests were rerun.
